typeName.description: Used internally to derive the shareable entity type from the type that mixes ExMachinaUserGroupShareableUi

allowViewDetails.description:
Whether the member viewing a record of a type mixing {@link ExMachinaUserGroupShareable} should be allowed to
view details of the shareable

allowShare.description:
Whether the member viewing a record of a type mixing {@link ExMachinaUserGroupShareable} should be allowed to
share the shareable

allowDelete.description:
Whether the member viewing a record of a type mixing {@link ExMachinaUserGroupShareable} should be allowed to
delete the shareable

allowDisable.description:
Whether the member viewing a record of a type mixing {@link ExMachinaUserGroupShareable} should be allowed to
disable the shareable

allowEnable.description:
Whether the member viewing a record of a type mixing {@link ExMachinaUserGroupShareable} should be allowed to
enable the shareable

allowEdit.description:
Whether the member viewing a record of a type mixing {@link ExMachinaUserGroupShareable} should be allowed to
edit the shareable

acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

isPubliclyAccessible.description: Whether this shareable can be accessed by all Ex Machina users

disabled.description: Whether the shareable entity is currently disabled, preventing use by the members who have access to it.

ownershipType.description: Used internally to derive the ownership type from the type that mixes ExMachinaUserGroupShareable

shareHistoryType.description: Used internally to derive the share history type from the type that mixes ExMachinaUserGroupShareable

currentOwner.description: Current owner of the shareable entity

displayOwner.description: A value for displaying the current owner in the UI. For a publicly available entity, uses "C3 AI" as the owner.

lastUpdatedBy.description: The last user to modify the entity. For a publicly available entity, uses "C3 AI" as the updater.

ownershipHistory.description: History of all owners of the shareable entity

activelyShared.description: Current groups with which the shareable entity has been shared

sharedHistory.description: History of all teams with which the shareable entity has been shared

isOwned.description: Flag that indicates whether logged in user is the current owner of the shareable entity

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

displayName.description: Display name of credential. Same as {@link DataConnectorCredential.displayName}

datastore.description: The data store type. Same as {@link DataConnectorCredential.datastore}

description.description: Custom description of the credential. Same as {@link DataConnectorCredential.description}

title:
A wrapper around {@link ExMachinaConnectorCredential} to provide additional fields that will change depending on the user
accessing the records.
name: ExMachinaConnectorCredentialUi
